title: Human-AI Collaboration in Conflict Analysis: Text Classifier Development with Peacebuilders

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the classification performance (Precision, Recall, F1) of participatory, locally fine-tuned BERT models against generic open-source models on context-specific datasets to evaluate the reduction in misclassifications driven by a lack of cultural nuance.

Using qualitative deliberation and inter-rater reliability metrics among local peacebuilders to identify and annotate locally coded language, dialects, and rapidly shifting terminology that generic toxicity taxonomies and keyword classifiers fail to detect.
